fields.description:
Source: Kobi / Joyce doc feedback + annotated screenshots, 2026-08-10.

Highlights panel: Operator · Partner · Market · Vertical · Owner

SECTION 1 — Deal Information

L: Deal Name | Operator | Partner | Market Country | Market Province / State

R: Vertical | Deal Status | Priority Tier | Owner | Deal Version

SECTION 2 — Commercial Terms

L: Payout Model | CPA Amount | Deposit Range | Monthly Cap | Qualifying Action

R: Currency | Avg Deposit Target

SECTION 3 — Redeposit Details

L: Redeposit Required | Immediate Redeposit Range

R: Redeposit Type (multi-select: Standard Redeposit; Immediate Redeposit)

SECTION 4 — Additional Details (NEW SECTION)

L: Effective Start Date | Notes

R: Effective End Date | Created

RELATED LISTS (only these two):

• Links — columns: Link | Tracking URL | Label | Default | Status | Reps. Keep the New button.

• Deal Rep Assignments — columns: Assignment ID | Rep (BA) | Brand Manager (BM) | Link Slug | Assigned | Status. Badges: 'Read-only' + 'Synced from CMS'. Helper text: 'A log of assignments returned by the CMS. Records are created and updated by the sync, never entered here.' Plus last-sync timestamp and a 'View sync log' link, and 'View All'.

⚠️ MAJOR FLAG: the DRA related list in the screenshots is designed READ-ONLY / CMS-OWNED. That was Joyce's 2026-07-28 decision, but it was REOPENED on 2026-08-04 (Emily: 'we're talking about basically just bringing the rep assignments back into Salesforce') and Joyce deferred rather than confirming. Do NOT build the read-only treatment until DECISION-01 lands, or we repeat the sunk build from the July 28 Manage Rep Assignment demo.

Dependencies: BUILD-118 (Market), BUILD-63 (Deal Links child object), BUILD-65 (DRA targets), DECISION-01 (DRA ownership).
